newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to create jobs in culture sector.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to create jobs in culture sector.

text.p: Belgium plans to create 8,000 temporary jobs in the culture, sports and welfare sector, Belgian Labour Minister Miet Smet said on Wednesday.
"We want to give local authorities the opportunity to create jobs in sports and culture," Smet told BRTN radio.

Local authorities and non-profit organisations will be able to get part of the unemployment benefits of the person who gets the job but will also have to pay part of the salary themselves. The scheme is designed for one-year contracts.
